# observe_status_page (Resource)

An additional status page.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "observe_status_page" "public" {
  title        = "Acme status"
  slug         = "acme"
  monitor_ids  = [observe_monitor.shop.id]
  accent_color = "#0f766e"
  auto_updates = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `monitor_ids` (List of String) Monitors on the page
- `slug` (String) Lowercase letters, digits and dashes; slugified for you
- `title` (String)

### Optional

- `accent_color` (String) Hex colour, e.g. #0f766e
- `auto_updates` (Boolean) Post an update automatically when a monitor on the page goes down and comes back
- `locale` (String) One of `en`, `es`, `fr`, `de`, `nl`, `pt`.
- `logo_url` (String)
- `message` (String)
- `organization_id` (String) Organization ID; defaults to the provider's `organization_id`
- `private` (Boolean) Only people with the private link can see it

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) ID
- `url` (String) Public URL

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# <organization_id>/<id>, or <id> when the provider sets organization_id
terraform import observe_status_page.example 01JCX4ZK7N2Q8V3W5Y6A9B0C1D/01JCX5A2B3C4D5E6F7G8H9J0K1
```
